title: Extending canonical Cohen power-series parameters along a local map
statement: Let c,n be natural numbers, Lambda a commutative ring, and R=Lambda[[X_1,...,X_n]] a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]. If c=0 assume Lambda is a field of characteristic zero; if c≠0 assume Lambda is a Cohen ring for c. Let B be a Noetherian complete local ring and g:R→B a local homomorphism. Let t be the list of X variables if c=0, or c followed by these variables otherwise. Then there are a coefficient ring Lambda_B in the common universe, an integer m, and S=Lambda_B[[W_1,...,W_m]] complete regular local, with Lambda_B a field if c=0 and a Cohen ring for c otherwise, a surjective local map v:S→B and a local map h:R→S with v h=g, and z such that t.map h ++ z is a regular system of parameters. No flatness or closed-fibre conclusion is asserted.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: The constant-coefficient kernel is the ideal of the variables. Splitting each series into its constant part and a series in this kernel proves m_R=m_Lambda R+(X). In the field case this is (X); in the Cohen case it is (c,X). The field/Cohen formal-smoothness theorem therefore applies to R over the integers.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: Show the residue field of B has characteristic c. If c=0, the composition Lambda→R→B→k_B is an injective field homomorphism, so k_B has characteristic zero. If c≠0, c is prime and nonunit in Lambda, hence in R, and locality makes its image zero in k_B. Thus CharP k_B c holds. Apply the Cohen presentation theorem to a universe lift of B, transporting completeness by the ring equivalence, and compose the resulting presentation with the equivalence back to B. Comparing residue characteristics forces the coefficient ring Lambda_B to be a field if c=0 and a Cohen ring for c otherwise.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: Let v:S_0→B be that presentation, I=m_{S_0}, J=ker v. Surjectivity gives map v I=m_B and locality gives J≤I. For x in every J+I^k, v x belongs to every m_B^k, hence vanishes by separatedness of complete B. Thus J is closed. Identify S_0/J with B and apply the formally smooth adic lifting theorem over the integers with t=r=1 to the local map g. Obtain phi:R→S_0 with v phi=g and phi(m_R)⊆I, hence phi local. The algebra structures over the integers are identified by uniqueness.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: Apply the fixed-map parameter-perturbation lemma to phi and the canonical list t. It gives complete regular S, pi:S→S_0 surjective local, and h:R→S local with pi h=phi, whose images of t extend to parameters. Compose v with pi; surjectivity and locality compose, and (v pi)h=v phi=g. Retain the same Lambda_B and its characteristic-dependent coefficient properties.

mathlib_searches.query: A local map of formal power series rings can be made to send canonical parameters into a regular system of parameters by adjoining independent variables to the target

A local homomorphism from power series over a characteristic zero field or Cohen ring into a complete Noetherian local ring factors through a power series ring with source parameters extending to target parameters

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cohen_power_series_parameter_extension
    {Λ : Type u} [CommRing Λ] (n c : ℕ)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ)]
    (hzero : c = 0 → IsField Λ ∧ CharZero Λ)
    (hpos : c ≠ 0 → IsCohenRing c Λ)
    {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B]
    (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ →+* B) [IsLocalHom g]
    (t : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ))
    (ht : t = if c = 0 then List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n ↦ (X i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ))
      else (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ) :: List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n ↦ X i)) :
    ∃ (ΛB : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing ΛB) (m : ℕ)
      (_ : IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛB)),
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛB))
        (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛB) ∧
      (c = 0 → IsField ΛB) ∧ (c ≠ 0 → IsCohenRing c ΛB) ∧
      ∃ (v : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛB →+* B)
        (h : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛB),
        Function.Surjective v ∧ IsLocalHom v ∧ IsLocalHom h ∧ v.comp h = g ∧
        ∃ z : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛB),
          IsLocalRing.IsRegularSystemOfParameters (t.map h ++ z)
